load_configuration: load a Hydra configuration from a config name with overrides and run mode into a DictConfig
load_sweep_config: load a sweep configuration from a master config and sweep overrides into a DictConfig
get_search_path: get the ConfigSearchPath object used by the ConfigLoader to locate configuration files
get_sources: get the list of ConfigSource objects registered with the ConfigLoader
list_groups: list all config group names under a given parent name in the config search path
get_group_options: get the list of option names for a given config group with optional filtering
